query: What happens if I have incentives accrued across a few months but only paid later? When will the payments attract CPF contribution?
reference_answer: Platform earnings and incentives attract CPF contribution when they are due and payable, not when they are accrued.For example, the CPF contributions on an incentive payment in June that is for trips done in May will be computed together with the rest of the June earnings.
answer: If you accrue incentives over several months but receive them all at once later, these payments will be considered as one lump sum income. According to CPF rules, such payments will attract CPF contributions starting from the month they are received. [Document 1]
